QUALITY ASSURANCE
Prospective PhD students must apply online, and their applications are evaluated by a public selection process. Admission to the PhD Program is by their ranking in the selection and the number of available positions. For full details on the PhD calls for admission, please refer to the information below.
Expired calls:
The Summer Call for Admission to the PhD Programme in Neuroscience (42nd Cohort) runs from 23 July 2026 to 26 August 2026 at 1:00 pm, Central European Summer Time.
Summer Call: Admission information — Call for Cohort 42, PhD in Neuroscience
General information, FAQs, and technical instructions are available at www.unipd.it/en/phd-programmes-calls-and-admissions.
Deadline for applications: 26 August 2026 at 1:00 pm (CEST)
When submitting their application, candidates are expected to include a short research project, which should be generally compatible with one or two research lines within the Padova Neuroscience Center. For the Summer Call 2026, only research lines No. 29, 31, 63, and 64 are eligible. The application process also includes the submission of other documents, such as an updated CV, a motivation letter, and two letters of recommendation.
Please read carefully all the documents and instructions concerning the call procedures, as failure to fulfill any of the requirements may result in the automatic exclusion from the competition.
Research Project Form: Project Form (Word), Project form (Pdf)
CV Form: CV form (Word), CV form (Pdf)
If, for any reason, candidates are unable to download any of the relevant documents, or have any questions about the application procedure, please send an email to phd DOT pnc AT unipd DOT it (DOT and AT to be replaced with the corresponding symbols).
Outcome of the evaluation of PhD candidates’ qualifications and interview schedule
Only candidates who scored above the threshold (35/50, corresponding to 7/10) can take the interview. To open the files below, candidates should use the password they received during the application process.

Scholarships for Chinese PhD students (42nd Cohort call, PhD in Neuroscience)
Candidates with Chinese citizenship who are interested in applying for CSC scholarships and wish to apply to the University of Padova for the next PhD cycle (expected to begin around November 2026) should submit their application in order to receive a letter of admission to the University of Padova’s PhD program, following the procedure outlined through the Guidelines for completing the online application form. The effective admission will be subject to the granting of the CSC scholarship.
Application deadline is 10 December 2025 at 13:00 (CET).
Selection procedure will be based on the evaluation of qualifications and an oral examination. The oral examination aims to assess the candidate’s motivation, their knowledge of the presented project, and to verify their excellent proficiency in the English language.
Summer Call: Admission information — Call for Cohort 41, PhD in Neuroscience
General information, FAQs, and technical instructions are available at www.unipd.it/en/phd-programmes-calls-and-admissions.
When submitting their application, candidates are expected to include a short research project, which should be generally compatible with one or two research lines within the Padova Neuroscience Center. For the Summer Call 2025, only research lines from No. 54 to No. 57 are eligible. The application process also includes the submission of other documents, such as an updated CV, a motivation letter, and two letters of recommendation.
Please read carefully all the documents and instructions concerning the call procedures, as failure to fulfill any of the requirements may result in the automatic exclusion from the competition.

Autumn Call: Admission information (40th Cohort call, PhD in Neuroscience) for prospective PhD students
There will be an extra call for PhD entrance exam with deadline for application from the 21st of October to the 21st of November (1 pm), with the oral exam approximately within the following period: 2-16 December 2024. Only research-bonded fellowships on PIs’ grants (borse a tema vincolato) and positions without fellowships will be advertised in this call (only research lines 52-56; details available here). Please check the PhD webpage for details on the upcoming call during the next weeks. Candidates should have obtained a master degree by December 2024.
The instructions will remain the same as in the previous calls (below).

Admission information (40th Cohort call, PhD in Neuroscience) for prospective PhD students:
Information concerning the current call for admission to our PhD Course in Neuroscience (Cohort 40th) will be available on this page and also here (Call opening: 9 April 2024; Deadline: 13 May 2024, at 1 pm, Central European Summer Time).
Please note that there will be a general procedure for Unipd and a sub-part of the call specific for the PhD in Neuroscience. Some research-bounded fellowships will be available in this call for the PhD in Neuroscience.
During the submission process for the entrance exam, candidates will be requested to write a short research project (the form can be downloaded below). This project should be generally compatible with some Research Lines within the Padova Neuroscience Center. The application process will also involve other requirements (e.g., submission of the CV according to the form provided below, motivation letter and recommendation letters). Please read all the documents and instructions concerning the Entrance Exam call procedures very carefully, as failing to fulfill all the requirements may result in the automatic exclusion from the competition.
If you have further questions, have a look at our FAQ and technical instructions.
